display_en: Case: At lunch, an adult cannot speak or cough effectively
narration_fil: Sa tanghalian, hindi makapagsalita o makaubo nang mabisa ang adult. May hiwalay na case card ng sanggol.
narration_en: At lunch, an adult cannot speak or cough effectively. A nearby infant case card shows a different age pathway.

Sundin ang kasalukuyang choking training ayon sa edad
Magsanay sa adult at infant manikin sa gabay ng trainer
display_en:
Call for help
Tell mild cough from severe obstruction
Follow current age-specific choking training
Practise adult and infant pathways only on manikins
narration_fil: Humingi ng tulong at sundin ang kasalukuyang choking training ayon sa edad. Ihiwalay ang mabisang ubo sa malubhang bara. Magsanay sa adult at infant manikin sa gabay ng trainer.
narration_en: Call for help and follow current age-specific choking training. Distinguish mild cough from severe obstruction. Practise the trainer-approved adult and infant pathways only on appropriate manikins.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi makapagsalita o makaubo nang mabisa ang adult. Ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: The adult cannot speak or cough effectively. What comes first?

options.fil: Hugutin muna ng daliri ang nasa loob ng bibig.
options.en: Sweep the mouth with a finger first.

options.fil: Hintayin kung maaalis ito sa pag-ubo.
options.en: Wait and see if coughing clears it.

options.fil: Humingi ng tulong at tingnan ang edad.
options.en: Call for help and check the age.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag gumawa ng bulag na paghugot sa bibig. Humingi muna ng tulong. 2: Hindi ito mabisang ubo: hindi siya makapagsalita o makaubo nang mabisa. Humingi agad ng tulong. 3: Tama. Humingi ng tulong, saka sundin ang kasalukuyang training ayon sa edad.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not use blind finger sweeps. Call for help first. 2: This is not a mild cough: the adult cannot speak or cough effectively. Call for help now. 3: Correct. Call for help, then follow current training for the person's age.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Hindi makapagsalita o makaubo: hindi mabisang ubo
Humihingi muna ng tulong si Lea
Adult card: adult manikin, pathway ng trainer
Card ng sanggol: infant manikin, walang adult thrust
display_en:
Cannot speak or cough: not a mild cough
Lea calls for help first
Adult card: adult manikin, trainer-approved pathway
Infant card: infant manikin, no adult thrusts
narration_fil: Nakita ni Lea na hindi makapagsalita o makaubo nang mabisa ang adult. Hindi ito mabisang ubo, kaya humihingi agad siya ng tulong. Sa adult manikin, sinusunod niya ang pathway na aprubado ng trainer. Sa card ng sanggol, lumilipat siya sa infant manikin at infant pathway. Walang adult thrust at walang bulag na paghugot sa bibig.
narration_en: Lea sees that the adult cannot speak or cough effectively. This is not a mild cough, so she calls for help at once. On the adult manikin, she follows the pathway the trainer approved. For the infant card, she switches to the infant manikin and the infant pathway, with no adult thrusts and no blind finger sweeps.

display_fil:
Huwag gumamit ng adult abdominal thrust sa sanggol
Huwag gumawa ng bulag na paghugot sa bibig
Huwag magsanay ng thrust sa totoong kapareha
display_en:
Do not use adult abdominal thrusts on an infant
Do not use blind finger sweeps
Do not rehearse thrusts on a live partner
narration_fil: Huwag gumamit ng abdominal thrust sa sanggol, bulag na paghugot sa bibig, o magsanay ng thrust sa totoong kapareha.
narration_en: Do not apply adult abdominal thrusts to an infant, use blind finger sweeps, or rehearse thrusts on a live partner.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Sa station, hawak mo ang case card ng sanggol. Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?
check.prompt_en: At the station, you pick up the infant case card. What should your practice show?

options.fil: Lumipat sa infant manikin at infant pathway.
options.en: Switch to the infant manikin and pathway.

options.fil: Adult abdominal thrust sa infant manikin.
options.en: Adult abdominal thrusts on the infant manikin.

options.fil: Thrust sa kapareha, nang marahan, para magsanay.
options.en: Thrusts on your partner, gently, to practise.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Infant manikin at infant pathway na aprubado ng trainer ang para sa card ng sanggol. 2: Hindi para sa sanggol ang adult abdominal thrust. Lumipat sa infant pathway. 3: Huwag kailanman magsanay ng thrust sa totoong kapareha, kahit marahan. Manikin lamang.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct. The infant card needs the infant manikin and the trainer-approved infant pathway. 2: Adult abdominal thrusts are not for infants. Switch to the infant pathway. 3: Never rehearse thrusts on a live partner, even gently. Use manikins only.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_en:
On Monday, with two manikins:
Tell cough from severe obstruction
Call for help
Show the supervised age-specific response
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Sa dalawang manikin, ihiwalay ang mabisang ubo sa malubhang bara at ipakita ang tugon ayon sa edad.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. With two training manikins, classify cough versus severe obstruction and show the supervised age-specific response.
